policies.title: A new Department for Growth Creation
policies.statement: Replace the Treasury with a new Department for Growth Creation, based outside London, focused on boosting long-term prosperity.

policies.title: Closer trade ties with Europe
policies.statement: Negotiate a better UK-EU trading relationship to cut red tape for business and raise billions a year for public services.

policies.title: Fix the social care crisis
policies.statement: Introduce free personal care for older and disabled people, funded through a cross-party long-term settlement for social care.

policies.title: Proportional representation
policies.statement: Replace Westminster's first-past-the-post voting system with a proportional one so every vote counts equally.

policies.title: Stop sewage dumping
policies.statement: Impose automatic fines on water companies that dump sewage into rivers and seas, with the money used to clean up waterways.

policies.title: Mental health support for all
policies.statement: Guarantee a dedicated mental health professional in every school and a walk-in mental health hub in every community.
